items.title: Firecracker VM Escape: PwnEscape Part 2
items.summary: A root-level escape from Firecracker microVMs is demonstrated by hijacking host memory and thread state to achieve code execution on the host. The exploit locates the Firecracker process in memory and redirects a live vCPU thread when it returns from KVM.
items.why_it_matters: The vulnerability allows untrusted code to escape the microVM and execute as root on the host, compromising the isolation boundary Firecracker is designed to enforce.
items.next_step_detail: Upgrade Firecracker to the latest patched version (e.g., sudo yum update firecracker).

items.title: Claude Code was mailing your email address to every website it visited: the User-Agent leak, the 5-month system-prompt issue, and the 5-point check
items.summary: Claude Code leaked user email addresses in HTTP User-Agent headers and system prompts, exposing verified developer identities to third-party servers and model logs. A fix was shipped in version 2.1.317 via the cc-plugin-privacy mod, though the original system-prompt issue remains open.
items.why_it_matters: The leak converted authentication data into a pre-qualified lead for scammers and rate-limiters, binding agent traffic to human identity without functional benefit.
items.next_step_detail: Upgrade Claude Code to version 2.1.317 or later.
